from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u085/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0411d424.py')
import os
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            y0=min(y for y,x in cells); x0=min(x for y,x in cells)
            rel={(y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in cells}
            objs.append((color,y0,x0,rel,max(y for y,x in cells)-y0+1))
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,y,x,rel,oh in objs:
        # Objects in the upper half collect at the top; those below collect at the bottom.
        top = y < h//2
        ny=0 if top else h-oh
        for dy,dx in rel: out[ny+dy][x+dx]=color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
